text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I need you to hear me out on something a bit serious.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Have you noticed? That my performance has been dropping lately. ...To the point where sheer heart can't fix it anymore.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I know you have your reasons.
But—pushing yourself past your limits won't win you the world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First, how about getting our bearings together?
To make our dream come true, right?

Seeking the Pearl departed with flair.
I suppose it's time to review our future plans.
